'''Berene''' was a province on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lianna/Legends|Lianna]] during the time it was ruled by the [[Kingdom of Barseg]]. Along with its neighbor, [[Caldara]], Berene was the site of a futile rebellion by the native [[Liann]]s against their oppressors. Berene was no longer an active part of the Lianna urban landscape by the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].
